<!-- Every section is required; its length isn't. A small change gets one line each.
     Say the rule and point to the code. Don't write the code in prose. -->

**Why:** <!-- one line, plus the one fact that justifies it -->

**Done means:** <!-- what's observably different; what must not change -->

**Where:** <!-- files or functions likely touched. Open these first, and name any refactor the change forces. -->

**Rule / change:** <!-- the behaviour to implement, not line-by-line steps -->

**Tests:** <!-- one line per case, separated by ·. For a fix, extend the existing tests and name them; new tests only for new behaviour. -->

**Depends on:** none
